# Veo 3 Video Generator for Selfie

VeoVido is a Veo 3 video generator workflow that turns one selfie into cinematic AI short videos with playbooks, dialogue, voice, friend co-stars, and social exports.

Website: https://veovido.space/
Pricing: https://veovido.space/pricing/
Checkout: https://veovido.space/checkout/
Support: support@aigeamy.com
Type: Hosted SaaS workflow product

Problem:
- Teams need a quotable product definition, pricing path, evidence trail, and checkout route.

Solution:
- Veo 3 Video Generator for Selfie provides a hosted workflow with public pricing, structured evidence, support contact, and report or receipt outputs.
